newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark pauses before push through 2.82.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark pauses before push through 2.82.

text.p: Sterling is seen consolidating before an eventual push higher, emboldened after retaining its foothold above 2.80 on an overnight stumble, said chartists.
"It came back to test that 2.80-mark area overnight, but the fact that it held there is pretty encouraging," said Alan Dunne, technical analyst at Bank America.
At 0735 GMT sterling/mark had recovered and was trading at 2.8148/57 after dipping to overnight lows of 2.8055 marks.
Dunne said with sterling/mark well supported, a move back through 2.82 marks was now possible with a re-test of the 4-1/2 year peaks around 2.8331 seen last week also inviting.
Dunne said the pair was building up strength for a push through 2.82 marks and then 2.8270/80 -- Friday's high -- before attempting to scale back up towards its recent peak around 2.8331 marks.
Sterling/mark is well buoyed by a short-term wedge formation which cuts in at around 2.8055 marks and a longer-term trendline slicing in at around 2.8020/2.8000 marks, said chartists.

On the upside, resistance above 2.8331 marks intervenes at around the 2.84-mark psychological area with monthly trendline resistance cutting in around the 2.85-mark level. Against the dollar, sterling was rangebound with a little upside momentum.
